a: Payment APIs must be idempotent so retries do not double-charge.
A ledger records every credit/debit for auditability and balance correctness.
PCI DSS is the security standard for handling cardholder data.
Tokenization replaces card numbers with tokens to reduce PCI scope.
3-D Secure adds an authentication step to reduce card fraud.
Settlement moves funds between banks/processors after authorization.
A chargeback is a forced reversal initiated by the cardholder's bank.
Escrow holds funds until conditions are met, common in marketplaces.
Payment webhooks notify your server of async status changes.
Multi-currency systems track FX rates, fees, and currency of record carefully.
